verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Resend has extensive API reference docs (resend-docs-1 through resend-docs-35) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (resend-probe-3), but nothing describes an interactive, in-browser 'try it out' console with runnable examples akin to Swagger UI or Postman-style playgrounds. Missing for 10: any mention of a live/interactive API explorer, runnable code snippets executed from the docs, or a sandboxed request-testing UI.
